name.value: Rusty Rail Outdoor B.B.Q. & Beer Garden

description.value: The Rusty Rail is a seasonal outdoor BBQ and beer garden located at the summit of Grouse Mountain, part of the broader Grouse Mountain resort complex above North Vancouver. It sits within the same destination that hosts the Grouse Bike Park, making it a natural post-ride stop for mountain bikers accessing the lift-served trails. The outdoor seating area faces the mountain environment with views toward Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Rusty Rail BBQ exists as an active dining venue within the Grouse Mountain resort complex, listed under 'Dining & Food' as 'The Rusty Rail BBQ.' The name on the website ('The Rusty Rail BBQ') differs slightly from the OSM name ('Rusty Rail Outdoor B.B.Q. & Beer Garden'), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Rusty Rail Outdoor B.B.Q. & Beer Garden' but the Grouse Mountain website refers to it as 'The Rusty Rail BBQ'.
Venue is atop Grouse Mountain and requires gondola (Skyride) access — not directly reachable by road cycling; primarily relevant to mountain bikers using the Grouse Bike Park.
OSM flags seasonal operation with a fixme tag ('Determine seasonal opening dates'); specific operating season is unconfirmed from website content.
No street address available — location is on the mountain summit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating seasonal restaurant confirmed on the Grouse Mountain website, located within a resort that hosts the Grouse Bike Park and caters to mountain bikers.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Grouse Bike Park is listed on the same website as opening June 5th, confirming this location is actively used by cyclists during the bike park season.
